1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device comprises hardware components that interact with software to produce a functional change in the operation of the apparatus beyond merely displaying descriptive material.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the current step causes a functional change in the display or operation of the apparatus.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a functional change to the user interface display.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting comprises a functional change to the user interface display.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the next step causes a functional change in the display or operation of the apparatus.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a functional change to the user interface display.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting comprises a functional change to the user interface display.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, and wherein the similarity metric comprises a comparison of specific action sequences or temporal patterns of user actions rather than merely comparing static descriptive content.

9. (Original) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the use of previous user experiences produces a functional change in the alignment computation that affects the operation of the apparatus.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor comprises hardware and software components that functionally interact to extract and process the steps.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device comprises hardware components that interact with software to produce a functional change in the operation of the apparatus; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the highlighting comprises a functional change to the user interface display; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the scrolling comprises a functional change to the user interface display.

14. (Cancelled)

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the use of previous user experiences produces a functional change in the alignment computation that affects the operation of the apparatus.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step comprises processing by hardware and software components that produce a functional change in the operation of a computer system.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step causes a functional change in the display or operation of a computer system.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a functional change to the user interface display.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step causes a functional change in the display or operation of a computer system.

21. 23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein the similarity metric comprises a comparison of specific action sequences or temporal patterns of user actions.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the use of previous user experiences produces a functional change in the alignment computation.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, wherein the extracting step comprises processing by hardware and software components.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, wherein the program instructions, when executed, cause the machine to produce a functional change in the operation of the machine beyond merely displaying descriptive material.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step comprises processing by hardware and software components that produce a functional change in the operation of a computer system; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment, wherein the highlighting comprises a functional change to the user interface display; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment, wherein the scrolling comprises a functional change to the user interface display.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, wherein the use of captured images produces a functional change in the alignment computation.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the use of previous user experiences produces a functional change in the alignment computation.

32. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, wherein the program instructions, when executed, cause the machine to produce a functional change in the operation of the machine beyond merely displaying descriptive material.
